We take traffic and parking concerns seriously. While Friday congregational prayers bring our largest attendance, we have taken significant steps to address this issue. Since January 2025, Dar Al Salam Islamic Center (DAIC) has organized a dedicated team of volunteers every Friday to direct traffic, assist with parking, and remind attendees to respect our neighbors and avoid blocking driveways or streets.

Unfortunately, when traffic issues do occur, they are often caused by individuals who are not members of our congregation or who do not follow our volunteers' instructions. Even so, we continue to educate attendees regularly and work diligently to minimize any inconvenience to our neighbors.

reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with SB stone. They were incredibly responsive and easy to work with throughout the entire process. They treat you like family. I wanted a flat marker that was larger than the standard 24 but smaller than a half ledger and they were equipped to accommodate my request for an in between size fairly easily. The turnaround time from start to finish was 3 weeks. The finished product was beautiful. I highly recommend their services.

reviews.name: Nikki Harden
reviews.text:
SB Stone Monuments provided excellent customer service and compassion during my family's time of grief.  My sister and I visited the showroom with heavy hearts to get a headstone for our dad.  Feras and Wesam both showed us numerous options in their impressive showroom and warehouse.

After we made our headstone selection, Wesam helped us design it on the computer.  He was very patient with us as we looked through many design options.

The craftsmanship of the headstone was exceptional, and it was completed within the timeframe Wesam told us.  The engraving is precise, and the stone itself is beautifully finished.  They even set up the appointment and delivery of the headstone to the cemetery.  It’s a lasting tribute that truly honors our Dad’s memory.

We are deeply grateful for their dedication and kindness during such a difficult and emotional time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Nikki, for your kind words and for trusting SB Stone Monuments with your dad’s memorial. It was truly an honor to work with you and your sister and help create a beautiful, lasting tribute to his memory. We’re grateful for your trust and appreciate you taking the time to share your experience. Our deepest condolences to you and your family. ❤️
